bugs.title: No try/catch on JSON.parse of WebSocket message
bugs.description: Invalid JSON from client crashes the handler — no error handling on JSON.parse(data)

bugs.title: No message size limit
bugs.description: No maxPayload or length check — client can send arbitrarily large messages, causing memory exhaustion

bugs.title: Users map never cleaned up on disconnect
bugs.description: users.delete(currentUser) is never called on 'close' event — users Map grows indefinitely

bugs.title: Broadcast sends to closed WebSocket connections
bugs.description: broadcast() doesn't check ws.readyState before sending — throws on closed connections

bugs.title: No HTML escaping on chat messages
bugs.description: User message text is broadcast as-is — if rendered as HTML by clients, enables stored XSS

bugs.title: No authentication on join — username spoofing
bugs.description: Anyone can join with any username including impersonating other users. No token/auth verification.

bugs.title: Message history grows unbounded in memory
bugs.description: messageHistory array is never truncated or persisted — unbounded memory growth over time
